# AXE2 prototype roadmap (generated by rf2/rf2_readiness.py)

'Ready to prototype' = every gate below green in this repository. That is MODELED and tool-checked: no fabricator review, no bench test (rule 3).

**Done: 1 of 40. Ready to start now: P0.1, P0.4, P0.5, P0.6, P3.6, P3.7, P3.9.**

**Critical path:** P0.1 -> P1.1 -> P1.2 -> P2.2 -> P2.8 -> P3.1 -> P5.1 -> P5.2

Already in place: head shells / trays / coil channel (head:BF); TXJ, TXF, MP1 v1, LR1, SH1, SB1R QA / QB boards (DRC 0); light plate; chassis v2 envelope + electronics envelopes + fold (chassis); system budgets / harness / thermal (system); audio path (audio); display + audio coding v3; REF3 rect sizing (ref3); continuous-boost ratings.
